translation.title: Translation Settings
translation.description: Translate the current tab with an OpenAI-compatible model. The result opens in a new tab and streams in as it is produced.
translation.apiKeyHint: Sent only to the endpoint above and stored locally in plain text.
translation.modelHint: The model name exposed by the endpoint.
translation.cnSuffixHint: Added before the extension, e.g. doc.md → doc-hero-cn.md.
translation.enSuffixHint: Added before the extension, e.g. doc.md → doc-hero-en.md.
translation.invalidBaseUrl: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL.
translation.unsavedMsg: This document has not been saved to disk yet. Save it first, then translate.
translation.unsavedMsgReadonly: This tab has no local file. Save the content as a Markdown file before translating.
translation.emptyResponse: The model returned an empty translation.
translation.keptNotSaved: The translation finished but was not written; it stays in the tab.
translation.targetOpen: The translation tab for {name} has unsaved changes. Save or close it first.

glossary.title: Word Gloss Settings
glossary.description: Endpoint used by the 词 and 句 reading modes for word glosses and sentence translations. It is separate from the translation settings.
glossary.apiKeyHint: Sent only to the endpoint above and stored locally in plain text.
glossary.modelHint: The model name exposed by the endpoint.
glossary.memoryOnly: This tab has no file on disk, so glosses are cached for this session only.
glossary.sentenceMemoryOnly: This tab has no file on disk, so sentence translations are cached for this session only.
glossary.speakOnClickHint: Takes effect immediately. When checked, left-clicking a word or sentence shows its gloss/translation and reads it aloud; in paragraph mode, opening a paragraph card reads the original aloud automatically.
glossary.phoneticHint: Takes effect immediately. When checked, clicking or Alt+clicking a word or phrase shows its IPA on its own line above the gloss.

paras.memoryOnly: This tab has no file on disk, so paragraph translations are stored in this browser's local storage only.
paras.changedTooltip: The English changed — confirm this translation again
paras.changedWarning: The English paragraph changed after this translation was saved. Review it and confirm again.
